$comment: The Virgo palette — the one place it is written down.
`node scripts/build-tokens.mjs` writes it into every client:
mobile/theme.tokens.ts            the phone app (NativeWind vars + literal hex)
web/src/app/tokens.css            web.virgo.ph, the desktop app, virgo.ph
and `--check` fails when any of them differ from this file. Edit here, never there.
Every foreground was measured against every surface it is drawn on and clears
WCAG AA (4.5:1) — see the note on each. The web copy used to lead with #B66A40,
which white text sits on at 4.09:1, and its dark primary at 3.50:1.
Names follow the phone app, which is what the other copies claimed to match.
`brandAccent` is the terracotta accent; `hover` is the neutral hover surface that
shadcn calls --accent on the web. They were one name meaning two things.

radius.$comment: Deliberately different per platform: touch targets read better a little rounder. Recorded here so the difference is a decision rather than a drift.

delivery.$comment: The client delivery page: its own small set, drawn from the palette above. `panelMuted` is the secondary text on the dark header panel — it was white at 45% (3.5:1) and is now 4.5:1 or better.
